The '''Noghri Overclan''' was the unified clans of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] were a clan-based species that lived in hierarchically-structured tribes, and the Noghri Overclan was the overall clan that they served. Honoghr was admitted into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] shortly after it was established. 

==History==
Following the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the Noghri considered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to be their overclan out of gratitude for the Empire's alleged actions in restoring Honoghr's ecosystem, which was being ravaged by an ecological disaster, and the planet become occupied by the Empire.<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="DFR" /> 

==Culture==
To defame the honor of the lord of the Noghri Overclan was an offense punishable by death,<ref name="TTS" /> and those accused of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Overclan were given over to the Noghri clan [[dynast]]s for judgment under the ancient rules of the species.<ref name="DFR" />
